title: Blinded Opus-Sol semantic judgment of the completed action-outcome packet, revision 2
registeredQuestion: Can two independently isolated model families reproducibly judge visible action delivery and immediate next-turn uptake from the frozen 35-case action-outcome packet?

priorRevision.result: exploratory_model_pair_failed: joint exact 17/33, paired indeterminacy 27/35, 5 consensus binary records
priorRevision.diagnosis: The packet is stall reports (23/35 learner replies say the learner stopped before the step). Revision 1 had no stall rule, so Sol read absence as failure or an echoed step as success while Opus read the same text as inconclusive. Two Opus rows were voided because the validator compared curly and straight apostrophes byte for byte. Both seats ran at low effort.
changes: codebook v2 adds a stall-report rule: a stall with no forbidden evidence is inconclusive; an echoed tutor step is not learner-authored application; stall is failure only when the expected evidence names disengagement
codebook v2 defines confidence and states the quotation-mark tolerance; it also states that a delivered action followed by a hand-back is still delivered
the validator compares evidence quotations after mapping curly apostrophes and quotation marks to straight ones and Unicode NFC normalization, and records when that mapping was needed
both seats run at medium effort; the same effort on both seats keeps the cross-family comparison unconfounded
new order seeds; everything else (packet, seats, ceiling, gates, dispositions, claim boundary) is unchanged
priorRevision.comparisonRule: Compare revision 2 against the archived revision-1 report and against the revision-1 responses re-scored under the revised validator (scripts/rescore-tutor-stub-action-outcome-model-judge-shadow.js). Closer agreement is a change in the instrument, not new evidence about the construct.

source.inputRule: The runner reads the packet for model prompts and the machine key only for post-judgment family, world, and frozen-auxiliary comparison. No machine-key field enters a model prompt.

instrument.quoteMarkNormalization: straight and curly apostrophes and quotation marks compare equal after Unicode NFC normalization; every other character must match exactly
instrument.stallReportRule: a stall report with no forbidden evidence is inconclusive, never failure by absence; an echoed tutor step is not success or partial

judges.failedOrInvalidResponseDisposition: preserve and continue; never replace, repair, or rerun the unit
judges.generatorExclusion: The source tutor, learner, and classifier used codex.gpt-5.6-luna; neither judgment seat uses Luna.
judges.effortRule: both seats use the same effort so the cross-family comparison stays unconfounded

attemptCeiling.meaning: Exactly one non-retried model request for each of two seats on each of 35 cases. The runner reserves before dispatch and fails before attempt 71.

analysis.primary: exact agreement on the joint delivery-plus-outcome label among cases with two protocol-valid responses
secondary: delivery exact agreement and Cohen kappa
outcome exact agreement and Cohen kappa
exact-consensus binary records by move family and world
agreement or disagreement with the frozen auxiliary observer
a preserved disagreement taxonomy with both evidence quotations
analysis.gateMeaning: These thresholds diagnose whether a paired model-semantic instrument is promising. Passing does not satisfy or amend the source study's registered human-review gates.

dispositions.exactNonbinaryConsensus: retain as partial, inconclusive, or measurement_indeterminate; never collapse to failure
dispositions.oppositeFrozenBinaryAuxiliary: report disagreement without changing either model label
dispositions.humanCoderFiles: verify their registered hashes before dispatch and again after completion; never read, write, or populate their labels
dispositions.controllerStudy: never licensed by this shadow study

claimBoundary: This shadow study can establish only cross-model reproducibility, protocol-validity, indeterminacy, and candidate binary-yield for semantic judgment of the frozen 35 simulated-learner cases. It cannot validate the construct without an external human anchor, satisfy the source study's registered human gates, establish learning or transfer, compare action-family effectiveness, or license the memory-controller study.
